title: Sean McVay: Myles Garrett is like Wolverine, healing fast, but we won't rush him back

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Sean McVay: Myles Garrett is like Wolverine, healing fast, but we won't rush him back
sources.description: "I'm reluctant to put a timeline on it. We know that he's going to miss those four weeks at a minimum," McVay said.
